mantras.name: Om Suryaya Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days during sunrise

mantras.name: Surya Gayatri Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Bhaaskaraaya Namaha | Om Jap Suryaya Sahasraanaam

fasting: Fast on Sundays — eat only once after sunset
Eat wheat-based meals on Sunday (no rice)
donations: Donate wheat, jaggery, or copper items on Sundays
Give red cloth or masoor dal to the needy
Feed a cow with wheat chapati on Sundays
pujaSteps: Wake before sunrise on Sunday and bathe with clean water
Face the East direction and offer water to the rising Sun from a copper vessel
Add a pinch of red flower petals and a spoon of jaggery to the water
Chant 'Om Suryaya Namaha' 108 times while offering
Light a mustard oil lamp with a cotton wick facing the Sun
Offer red flowers and wheat grains to the Sun altar
Read or listen to the Aditya Hridayam Stotram
Distribute wheat or jaggery as prasad
temples: Visit a Surya Mandir (Sun Temple) — such as Konark or Modhera
Offer water mixed with red flowers to the Sun at sunrise
Perform Surya Namaskar daily at dawn
sun.deityDescription: temples: Konark Sun Temple, Modhera Sun Temple

mantras.name: Om Chandraya Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days after moonrise

mantras.name: Chandra Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Shram Shreem Shraum Sah Chandraya Namaha

mantras.name: Durga Saptashati
mantras.practice: Recite on Mondays, especially during Moon Mahadasha

fasting: Fast on Mondays — eat only after moonrise
Consume only milk-based foods on Mondays
donations: Donate white rice, milk, or white cloth on Mondays
Give silver items or pearls to a girl or woman
Feed kheer (rice pudding) to elderly women
pujaSteps: Bathe and wear clean white clothes on Monday evening
Set up a small altar with a Shiva Lingam or Moon image
Offer raw milk, white flowers, and bilva (bael) leaves to the Lingam
Light a ghee lamp with a white cotton wick
Chant 'Om Chandraya Namaha' 108 times or the Beej Mantra 108 times
Offer kheer (rice pudding) as naivedyam
Distribute kheer or white sweets as prasad
Sleep facing the East or South-East
temples: Visit Shiva temples on Mondays
Offer white flowers and milk to Shiva Lingam
Perform Jal Abhishekam (water offering) at the temple
moon.deityDescription: worship via Lord Shiva temples on Mondays

mantras.name: Om Mangalaya Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days

mantras.name: Mangal Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Kraam Kreem Kraum Sah Bhaumaya Namaha

fasting: Fast on Tuesdays — eat only one full meal after sunset
Eat only jaggery-based sweets on Tuesday evenings
donations: Donate red lentils (masoor dal), copper, or red cloth on Tuesdays
Give sweets to younger brothers or male friends
Feed monkeys bananas or jaggery
pujaSteps: Wear clean red or orange clothes on Tuesday
Visit a Hanuman temple or set up a small Hanuman image at home
Apply sindoor (vermillion) to the Hanuman idol
Offer red flowers, jaggery, and red masoor dal
Light a mustard oil lamp in front of Hanuman
Chant 'Hanuman Chalisa' 7 times or 'Om Mangalaya Namaha' 108 times
Read the Sunderkand path
Distribute sweets or laddoo as prasad
temples: Visit Hanuman temples every Tuesday
Apply sindoor (vermillion) to Hanuman idol
Offer red flowers and sweets to Hanuman
mars.deityDescription: worship via Hanuman temples on Tuesdays

mantras.name: Om Budhaya Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days

mantras.name: Budh Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Bram Breem Braum Sah Budhaya Namaha

fasting: Fast on Wednesdays — eat green vegetables only
Consume green moong dal khichdi as the only meal
donations: Donate green gram (moong), green cloth, or books on Wednesdays
Give green-colored sweets or fruits
Donate to schools or educational institutions
pujaSteps: Wear green or light green clothes on Wednesday
Set up a small Vishnu or Krishna image at home
Offer green moong dal, green cloth, and fresh green leaves
Light a ghee lamp with a green cotton wick
Chant 'Om Budhaya Namaha' 108 times
Offer green sweets (like pista barfi) as naivedyam
Read Vishnu Sahasranamam or a chapter from the Bhagavad Gita
Donate books or educational items to students
temples: Visit Vishnu temples on Wednesdays
Offer green moong dal or green sweets to the deity
Recite Vishnu Sahasranamam at the temple
mercury.deityDescription: worship via Lord Vishnu temples on Wednesdays

mantras.name: Om Brihaspataye Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days

mantras.name: Guru Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Gram Greem Graum Sah Gurave Namaha

fasting: Fast on Thursdays — eat yellow moong dal or chana dal khichdi
Consume only yellow-colored foods on Thursday
donations: Donate yellow cloth, turmeric, chana dal, or gold on Thursdays
Give yellow sweets (laddoo) to a priest or teacher
Donate books or educational material to a temple or library
pujaSteps: Wear clean yellow clothes on Thursday
Set up a Guru or Vishnu image with yellow cloth underneath
Offer yellow flowers, turmeric, chana dal, and banana
Light a ghee lamp with a yellow cotton wick
Chant 'Om Brihaspataye Namaha' 108 times or the Beej Mantra
Offer yellow kheer or laddoo as naivedyam
Read a chapter from the Vishnu Purana or Bhagavad Gita
Donate yellow items or books to a Brahmin or teacher
temples: Visit Vishnu or Devi temples on Thursdays
Offer yellow flowers and banana to the deity
Donate to a Brahmin family on Thursday
jupiter.deityDescription: worship via Lord Vishnu or Devi temples on Thursdays

mantras.name: Om Shukraya Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days

mantras.name: Shukra Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Draam Dreem Draum Sah Shukraya Namaha

fasting: Fast on Fridays — eat only one meal of sweet food
Consume white sweets (like kheer) after sunset on Friday
donations: Donate white sweets, curd, white cloth, or silver on Fridays
Give perfume, sugar, or ghee to women
Donate to artists or the arts community
pujaSteps: Wear clean white clothes on Friday evening
Set up a Lakshmi image or Shiva-Parvati image with white flowers
Offer white flowers, curd, kheer, and sugar
Light a ghee lamp with a white cotton wick
Chant 'Om Shukraya Namaha' 108 times or the Beej Mantra
Recite the Lakshmi Stotram or Kanakadhara Stotram
Offer white sweets (kheer or payasam) as naivedyam
Donate white items, perfume, or sweets to women in need
temples: Visit Lakshmi temples on Fridays
Offer white flowers and kheer to the goddess
Light a ghee diya (lamp) at the temple
venus.deityDescription: worship via Goddess Lakshmi temples on Fridays

mantras.name: Om Shanaishcharaya Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days

mantras.name: Shani Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaischaraya Namaha

fasting: Fast on Saturdays — eat only one meal after sunset
Eat black sesame (til) based food on Saturday
donations: Donate black cloth, black sesame, iron items, or mustard oil on Saturdays
Give food (especially rice and urad dal) to the elderly or disabled
Feed crows with rice mixed with black sesame
pujaSteps: Wear clean black or dark blue clothes on Saturday
Set up a Shani image or Peepal tree altar
Pour mustard oil on a Shani idol or under a Peepal tree
Offer black sesame seeds, black urad dal, and iron items
Light a sesame oil lamp under a Peepal tree
Chant 'Om Shanaishcharaya Namaha' 108 times or the Beej Mantra
Read the Shani Stotram or Navagraha Stotram
Give food, black cloth, or iron items to the needy
temples: Visit Shani temples on Saturdays
Pour mustard oil on a Shani idol
Light a sesame oil lamp under a Peepal tree
saturn.deityDescription: worship at Shani temples on Saturdays, or under a Peepal tree

mantras.name: Om Rahave Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days

mantras.name: Rahu Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Bhram Bhreem Bhraum Sah Rahave Namaha

fasting: Fast on Saturdays — eat only after sunset
Eat only coconut-based foods on the day of the fast
donations: Donate blue cloth, coconut, or mustard oil
Give blankets or bedsheets to the homeless
Donate to anti-addiction or rehabilitation organizations
pujaSteps: Wear clean dark blue or grey clothes
Set up a Durga or Rahu image with blue cloth underneath
Offer blue flowers, coconut, mustard oil, and blue sweets
Light a mustard oil lamp with a blue cotton wick
Chant 'Om Rahave Namaha' 108 times or the Beej Mantra
Recite the Durga Kavach or Durga Saptashati
Offer coconut and blue sweets as naivedyam
Donate blue cloth, blankets, or coconut to the needy
temples: Visit a Durga temple on Saturdays
Offer blue flowers and sweets to the goddess
Perform Rahu Kalam prayers at home
rahu.deityDescription: worship via Goddess Durga temples on Saturdays

mantras.name: Om Ketave Namaha
mantras.practice: Chant 108 times daily for 40 consecutive days

mantras.name: Ketu Beej Mantra
mantras.transliteration: Om Sram Sreem Sraum Sah Ketave Namaha

fasting: Fast on Tuesdays — eat only khichdi (rice + moong dal)
Eat only vegetarian, sattvic food on the fast day
donations: Donate grey cloth, sesame, or blankets
Give food to dogs or stray animals
Donate to spiritual or ashram organizations
pujaSteps: Wear clean grey or brown clothes on Tuesday
Set up a Ganesha image or Ketu image with grey cloth
Offer durva grass, modak, and grey sesame seeds
Light a ghee lamp with a grey cotton wick
Chant 'Om Ketave Namaha' 108 times or the Beej Mantra
Recite the Ganesha Atharvashirsha or Ganapati Stotram
Offer modak or laddoo as naivedyam
Feed dogs or stray animals with food
temples: Visit Ganesha temples on Tuesdays
Offer durva grass and modak to Ganesha
Meditate at a temple dedicated to ancestors (Pitru)
ketu.deityDescription: worship via Lord Ganesha temples on Tuesdays
